degenerateReason: Every seed that holds a parent.inner holds its aString, so the negated presence is false for it, and every seed without a parent or a parent.inner is a missing-path error. The case exists for those error rows, which a presence test that guards only the parent returns.
intent: !has(parent.inner.aString): absence of a field two hops across the to-one relations.
trap: A missing parent and a missing parent.inner are both errors that deny under both polarities; guarding only a mapped parent, and not the unmapped parent.inner below it, returns the rows whose parent has no inner.
